lines: Yukti Refinery – CDU-1   |   Inspection & Corrosion Section
ULTRASONIC THICKNESS SURVEY — E-310 shell
Report No: UT-E310-2026-07     Date of survey: 2026-09-18
Equipment: E-310 Crude / diesel pumparound exchanger, shell side (CS, SA-516 Gr.70)
Nominal thickness: 10.0 mm     Minimum required thickness: 6.5 mm
Instrument: UT gauge DM-5E (cal. 2026-08-02), probe 5 MHz dual element
TML | Location | Prev. 2023 (mm) | Current (mm) | Remark
TML-01 | Shell top, inlet end | 9.4 | 9.1 | OK
TML-02 | Shell bottom, inlet end | 8.7 | 8.2 | OK
TML-03 | Shell top, mid | 9.2 | 9.0 | OK
TML-04 | Shell bottom, mid | 7.9 | 7.1 | Monitor
TML-05 | Shell bottom, outlet end | 7.3 | 6.1 | BELOW MIN
TML-06 | Shell top, outlet end | 9.0 | 8.8 | OK
TML-07 | Inlet nozzle N1 | 8.5 | 8.3 | OK
TML-08 | Outlet nozzle N2 | 8.1 | 7.6 | OK
Finding: TML-05 (shell bottom, outlet end) measured 6.1 mm, BELOW minimum required 6.5 mm.
Corrosion rate TML-05: 0.40 mm/yr (short term). Remaining life: nil. Fitness-for-service required.
Recommendation: Take E-310 out of service at next opportunity; repair / replace shell course;
raise CM work order; notify Operations (CDU-1) and Mechanical Head.
Inspector: Rohan Desai (ASNT UT Level II, Cert. No. UT-II-4471)
Reviewed by: Irfan Shaikh, Head - Mechanical
